title: Astro Practice
description: Practise the twelve ideas in this Astro course. Choose an answer, then read why it fits the example.

exercises.question: When does this frontmatter run in a static site?
exercises.explanation: An .astro page combines a frontmatter script with HTML-like markup. Frontmatter runs while Astro builds or renders the page.

exercises.question: Which folder creates routes?
exercises.explanation: Astro uses the pages folder to create routes. A file named books.astro creates a books page.

exercises.question: Does a normal Astro page link require a React router?
options: No, a normal HTML link works
exercises.explanation: Astro pages can use ordinary HTML links. A normal link works without adding a client router.

exercises.question: Where does an Astro component read its props?
exercises.explanation: An Astro component can read values from Astro.props. A parent passes those values as attributes on the component.

exercises.question: What does slot show in this layout?
options: Every file in the public folder
exercises.explanation: A layout component can provide the outer page structure. A slot marks where a page puts its own content.

exercises.question: Does the browser need to run this map to see the list?
options: Yes, every static list needs a browser framework
No, the build produces the list HTML
exercises.explanation: A static data array can become HTML during the Astro build. The browser receives the finished list without needing to run the map call.

exercises.question: What is the default reach of these component styles?
options: Every unrelated page on the internet
exercises.explanation: Styles in an Astro component are scoped by default. They can style that component without using a global rule for the whole site.

exercises.question: Which code runs in the browser here?
exercises.explanation: A script tag can run client-side JavaScript on an Astro page. Use it only for the page behaviour you actually need.

exercises.question: What URL serves public/club.svg?
exercises.explanation: The public folder holds files copied without processing. Their URLs start at the site root.

exercises.question: What does getStaticPaths list?
exercises.explanation: A bracketed page can use a route value. For static output, getStaticPaths lists the pages Astro should create.

exercises.question: What does client:load ask Astro to do?
options: Hydrate this component in the browser
Turn the whole site into a database
exercises.explanation: An island is a component that receives browser JavaScript only when a client directive asks for it. The rest of the page can stay plain HTML.

exercises.question: What does a static Astro build produce?
options: A requirement for a login database
HTML and assets for a static host
exercises.explanation: A static build produces HTML and assets that a static host can serve. Inspecting the output helps you see how little client code a content page needs.
